brief: c286: the river cannot freeze what its own flood covers. ICE_CELLS is built from onChannel at BUILD time, when column 127 was still SIDE — and #192 then widened onChannel so a winter lap is river to the cache. The list was already frozen, so a towpath cell the high water lies over can never take ice. At midwinter the margin is iced and the open water lying on the towpath beside it is not: shots/ice-east.png. Make the ice read the channel the world actually has in winter, not the one it had at build. Fidelity is 3 of 195 iterations, the thinnest column in the grid, and this is exactly what the kind means — the world keeping a promise it already makes.
successLooksLike: At midwinter there is no open water lying on an iced margin: the lap freezes with the channel it belongs to. The census's WINTER block moves frozen/margin and the SUMMER nine are byte-identical — both on a pinned ref, per #187's --ref.
avoid: water counts ICE, so this redefines a gate's subject: LAWS says re-run every gate that READS it, not only the one briefed — the winter ladder AND the summer nine, on a ref, not on HEAD. Do not rebuild ICE_CELLS every tick if a cheaper answer exists; #191 measured the ground cache at 76.03 repaints/day and c285 says nobody is watching that bar between briefs. Quote it.
